description: SIMULATED. Native snap7 server (python-snap7 1.4.1) on 127.0.0.2:102; eval/sim/s7_identity_query.py from 127.0.0.1 reads SZL 0x0011 and 0x001C twice (rack 0 slot 2).

capture.method: Npcap loopback capture via eval/sim/capture_lo.py, converted to Ethernet by eval/sim/sim_lab.py convert
capture.notes: Snap7 server identity is FIXED in the native library (not configurable): order 6ES7 315-2EH14-0AB0, firmware V3.2.6, serial S C-C2UR28922012, module_name/module_type 'CPU 315-2 PN/DP', as_name 'SNAP7-SERVER', mmc_serial 'MMC 267FF11F' (frames 14, 18, 37, 41). MACs are synthetic (02:00:00:00:00:<last IP octet>): the Npcap loopback capture (link type 0) has no Ethernet header, so eval/sim/sim_lab.py convert rewrote each frame as Ethernet. Identity values come from the simulator config, not real hardware. Reproduce: eval/sim/RECORD.md.

implied by S7comm + 6ES7 order number (SZL carries no vendor string)
